step: gannenet (40) — the marketing surfaces sold four features the app does not have, at a price nobody set
how_measured: Every claim on the three copy surfaces (home, nav+footer on every page, /pricing) was checked against the source: a case-sensitive scan of all 45 .ts/.tsx/.js files under apps/40-gannenet for the thing each claim names, plus reading the page that would implement it.

false_claims_found.evidence: no route, no component, no handler. Nav lists 7 destinations and none is a wizard; `next build` renders 65 pages and none is one.

0 hits for whatsapp/וואטסאפ outside those two strings. app/newsletter/page.tsx has two text inputs and one button that sets state; it renders the draft into a <div> — no image field, no send, not even a copy button.
false_claims_found.fix: card now describes what the page does; removed from /pricing

false_claims_found.claim: מוכן להדפסה ו-PDF (המחולל) / הורדה ל-PDF ולהדפסה
false_claims_found.evidence: app/generator/page.tsx renders title + instructions + two <ul>s. No print(), no export, no download. The only print path in the app is components/PdfViewer.tsx, which is the shelf's file viewer — a different feature.
false_claims_found.fix: card now names what the generator returns; removed from /pricing

false_claims_found.claim: 3 הפקות AI בחודש (חינם) / הפקות AI ללא הגבלה (פרימיום) / גישה מוגבלת למאגר
false_claims_found.evidence: there is no account system in this app — the only login() is the admin-key prompt on /shelf/admin — and no counter, quota or gate anywhere. /library, /shelf and /generator are open to anyone. So the tier split described a product that does not exist and everything listed as paid was in fact free.
false_claims_found.fix: the page now states what is open (all of it) instead of splitting it

false_claims_found.evidence: more30-priority.md §8א fixes the platform scale at 2/5/10/12/15 ₪. 49 is not on it and is in no core.plans row.
false_claims_found.fix: no number is quoted; the tier reads בהכנה and names the real 2–15 ₪ scale as the platform's, with the mapping for #40 left undecided

false_claims_found.evidence: the shelf serves 2,977 items (measured repeatedly this week, /api/drive-catalog).

dead_ctas_found.was: three buttons — התחלה חינם / מנוי פרימיום / דברו איתנו — all href=/library
dead_ctas_found.now: one button, למאגר המערכים, which is where it goes

dead_ctas_found.was: the one prominent button read הרשמה and went to /pricing
dead_ctas_found.now: כניסה למאגר → /library. There is no sign-up in this app, so the button could not have been honoured.

also: footer credit link פותח ע״י עולם הסטארטאפים → https://more30.com, per more30-priority §7. It was absent; the footer carried no developer credit at all.

verification.assertions: 13 string assertions for claims that must be gone and 6 for what must be there — all pass. Two apparent failures were artifacts and were run down: '49' matches lineHeight:49px inside Next's built-in 404 RSC payload, and 'כל 52 המערכים' renders as 'כל <!-- -->52<!-- --> המערכים' because React separates the interpolated count.
verification.console: 0 errors on / and /pricing (1 pre-existing warning: apple-mobile-web-app-capable deprecation, from layout.tsx)
verification.counts: home feature cards 7 → 6; the 52 on /pricing is computed from content/mashlima.json + content/regular.json, not typed in
